sn22.29:1.2: Yo bhikkhave rūpam abhinandati dukkhaṃ so abhinandati ||

sn22.29:1.7: Yo viññāṇam abhinandati dukkhaṃ so abhinandati ||

sn22.29:1.9: Yo ca kho bhikkhave rūpam nābhinandati dukkhaṃ so nābhinandati
sn22.29:1.14: Yo viññāṇaṃ nābhinandati dukkhaṃ so nābhinandati ||
